Loosening any limit — Rules or the friction toggles below — is delayed, never instant. This is friction against your own future impulse, not a technical lock; it says when a change takes effect, not that it can't be changed.
Optional: pick an accepted friend to gate your loosening changes instead of the timer above. When set, a loosening waits on their approval — not on the clock — and a rejection cancels it outright.
